what_changed: Board and CFPB raise the TILA/Regulation Z exempt-transaction threshold (12 CFR 1026.3(b)(1)(ii); comment 3(b)-3 in Supplement I to Part 1026, and 12 CFR 226.3(b) for the Board) from $69,500 to $71,900 for 2025, by the annual CPI-W adjustment. Loans secured by real property or a principal dwelling and private education loans stay covered regardless of amount.
rationale: Full text confirms a mechanical inflation adjustment to TILA coverage; no servicing, contact, payment or disclosure conduct changes. It only moves the size limit above which non-mortgage consumer loans are exempt, which touches servicing only at the margin (e.g., whether a refinancing of a loan near the limit needs new 1026.20(a) disclosures), so confidence stays below the auto-close line.
